description: Register a Google Jules (Gemini) trigger. Creates (or idempotently updates) a coding-agent **trigger** connector — the recurring, unattended run that burns down the ops queue in `--pr` mode. Discriminated on `provider`; only the four Shipeasy-fireable providers are accepted (`claude_trigger`, `cursor_trigger`, `copilo…

apiKey.description: Jules API key that launches the session (secret). Encrypted into the credentials cipher; never returned.

config.description: Non-secret config for a Jules trigger.

projectId.description: Shipeasy project id the run targets.

source.description: Jules source for the connected repo, e.g. `sources/github/owner/repo`. Idempotency key for the connector.

startingBranch.description: Optional branch the session starts from.

enabled.description: Whether the trigger is active on create.

events.description: Events that auto-fire a Jules session. Defaults to empty.

items.description: Lifecycle event a connector subscribes to. `bug.created` fires when a new bug report lands in the feedback inbox; `feature_request.created` fires for a new feature request. A connector dispatches (posts to Slack / appends a Sheets row / files a GitHub Issue) — or, for trigger connectors, auto-fires a coding-agent run — once per subscribed event.

opsKey.description: Restricted Shipeasy ops key, embedded in the prompt (Jules exposes no env channel) (secret). Encrypted; never returned.

name: ops_trigger_create_jules
